title: Invoke key stays in Secrets Manager (decision) and optional OAC spike
description: Part of story chatticus-a170754a (Secrets and generated keys live in SSM Parameter Store SecureString, created by infrastructure code); read its description for the full plan, order and hazards. Decision: the invoke key feeds the CloudFront origin custom header through a CloudFormation dynamic reference (infra/lib/web-stack.ts) and ssm-secure is not supported for that property; rotate-invoke-key.sh and invoke-key-source.ts depend on AWSCURRENT and AWSPREVIOUS stages. Three secrets stay (1.20 USD per month). Optional spike: CloudFront Origin Access Control to the Function URL with AWS_IAM auth would delete the invoke key entirely; check the POST payload hash requirement and response streaming first.
